name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy's own mana-doubling trigger -> tripled nonland mana

prerequisites.timing: Any time a nonland permanent you control is tapped for mana (most commonly during a main phase while developing mana dorks/rocks).
other: Delney's oracle text: 'Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater.' and 'If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.'

Kinnan's oracle text: 'Whenever you tap a nonland permanent for mana, add one mana of any type that permanent produced.' (a triggered ability) plus a separate unrelated activated ability ({5}{G}{U}: look at top five, may put a non-Human creature into hand).

Kinnan's power is 2 (confirmed via data/cards_cache/oracle-2026-08-12/, scryfall_id 63cda4a0-0dff-4edb-ae67-a2b7e2971350), so Kinnan itself qualifies for Delney's doubling of its OWN triggered ability - this does not require a third card.

Mechanically: tapping any nonland permanent you control for mana (a mana dork such as Noble Hierarch, Avacyn's Pilgrim, Birds of Paradise, Elves of Deep Shadow, Delighted Halfling, or a mana rock/artifact) for N mana triggers Kinnan's ability once normally; with Delney in play, that trigger happens an additional time (twice total), each instance adding one mana of a type that permanent produced. Net result for a 1-mana tap: 1 (original) + 1 (first Kinnan trigger) + 1 (Delney-doubled second Kinnan trigger) = 3 total mana, i.e. nonland mana sources are effectively tripled rather than the usual Kinnan-alone doubling.
This does not apply to tapping lands for mana (Kinnan's trigger condition explicitly excludes lands), so it does not touch Gaea's Cradle or basic/nonbasic lands directly.

Not a loop and not infinite by itself - it is a static multiplier on every nonland mana tap, bounded by however many nonland mana sources are tapped that turn. Could combine with existing infinite-mana lines (e.g. interactions/verified/INT-0002.json, interactions/candidate/INT-0003.json) but does not change 'infinite' into anything larger there - its value is specifically for the deck's non-infinite mana-dork base.

result.summary: Every tap of a nonland permanent you control for mana produces triple the mana instead of Kinnan's usual double, as long as both Delney and Kinnan are on the battlefield.

sources.reference: Independent reasoning about Delney's 'power 2 or less' triggered-ability-doubling clause applied to Kinnan's own power (2) and its own mana-doubling trigger, prompted by the charter's named priority category 'Delney interactions'.
